description: Authoritative data source map for CMGF binding layer. In production, these systems provide signals to the CMGF engine. In demo mode, representative data is used.

personnel.label: Military Personnel & Training
personnel.description: Service member capability baseline — MOS skills, rank, training history, certifications earned in service
personnel.cmgf_use: Capability alignment, experience substitution, career readiness signals

education.label: Education Records
education.description: Academic readiness — civilian and military education, credentials, transfer credits
authoritative_systems: ACE (American Council on Education) Military Guide
education.cmgf_use: Education gap analysis, degree completion feasibility, time-to-completion estimates

funding.label: Funding & Benefits
funding.description: Financial feasibility — TA/CA balances, GI Bill status, benefit eligibility windows
funding.cmgf_use: Financial feasibility, policy friction detection, timeline constraints

workforce.label: Workforce & Labor Market
workforce.description: Employment outcomes — occupation demand, wages, certification requirements, job growth
workforce.cmgf_use: Career outcome modeling, ROI signals, pathway prioritization

providers.label: Institutional Providers
providers.description: Pathway availability — degree programs, credential vendors, delivery modes, transfer agreements
providers.cmgf_use: Pathway generation, timeline estimation, transfer feasibility

personal.label: Personal Constraints
personal.description: Individual context — family obligations, geographic limits, timeline preferences, financial stress
personal.cmgf_use: Risk modeling, feasibility adjustments, advisor personalization

level_1.label: Manual Entry
level_1.description: User enters data directly (current demo mode)

level_2.label: API Integration
level_2.description: Systems provide data feeds via secure APIs

level_3.label: Federated Environment
level_3.description: Real-time institutional binding with authoritative systems

governance_statement: CMGF does not replace authoritative systems. It binds signals from them into transparent decision-support outputs.
